crossRefs.note: Turning to the disciples, he said privately, “Blessed are the eyes which see the things that you see,
for I tell you that many prophets and kings desired to see the things which you see, and didn’t see them, and to hear…
In them the prophecy of Isaiah is fulfilled, which says, ‘By hearing you will hear, and will in no way understand…
The woman said to him, “I know that Messiah comes, he who is called Christ. When he has come, he will declare to us all…
Jesus said to her, “I am he, the one who speaks to you.”
“You search the Scriptures, because you think that in them you have eternal life; and these are they which testify…
But this is what has been spoken through the prophet Joel:
“Brothers, I may tell you freely of the patriarch David, that he both died and was buried, and his tomb is with us to…
But the things which God announced by the mouth of all his prophets, that Christ should suffer, he thus fulfilled.

translations.web: He began to tell them, “Today, this Scripture has been fulfilled in your hearing.”
translations.bsb: and He began by saying, “Today this Scripture is fulfilled in your hearing.”
translations.kjv: And he began to say unto them, This day is this scripture fulfilled in your ears.
translations.asv: And he began to say unto them, To-day hath this scripture been fulfilled in your ears.
